params.description: Filter by updatedAt date FROM the provided value as an ISO UTC string. Inclusive.

info.name: Get an Asset by its internal ID

params.name: id
params.description: The asset's internal ID

params.name: associations
params.description: Define which associations should be included in the response.

items.docs: Returns a single asset identified by its internal ID. Supports optional population of related resources via query parameters.

info.name: Update an Asset by its internal ID

params.name: id
params.description: The asset's internal ID

items.docs: Partially updates an existing asset identified by its internal ID. Only the fields provided in the request body are modified. Returns 204 on success.

info.name: Delete an Asset by its internal ID

params.name: id
params.description: The asset's internal ID

items.docs: Permanently deletes the asset identified by its internal ID. Returns 204 on success. Fails with 409 if the asset is a parent to other assets.

info.name: Get an Asset by its number

params.name: assetNumber
params.description: The asset's number (must be URL encoded)

params.name: associations
params.description: Define which associations should be included in the response.

items.docs: Retrieves a single asset by its unique asset number. The asset number must be URL-encoded. Returns 409 if multiple assets share the same number.

info.name: Update an Asset by its number

params.name: assetNumber
params.description: The asset's number (must be URL encoded)

items.docs: Partially updates a single asset identified by its unique asset number. The asset number must be URL-encoded. Returns 409 if the update would create a duplicate asset number and asset-type combination.

info.name: Delete an Asset by its number

params.name: assetNumber
params.description: The asset's number (must be URL encoded)

items.docs: Permanently deletes a single asset identified by its unique asset number. The asset number must be URL-encoded. Returns 409 if the asset is a parent to other assets or if multiple assets share the same number.
